description: This file defines a wizard interface for creating and managing account move entries in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including form definitions, data processing functions, and wizard states.

classes.name: use_model
classes.description: Wizard class for managing account move entries, including creating entries and opening move forms.

methods.name: _create_entries
methods.description: Creates account move and move line entries based on selected models and lines.

methods.name: _open_moves
methods.description: Opens a window displaying the created account move entries.

methods.name: _check
methods.description: Determines the next wizard state based on the selected model.
